description: Structured intent-routing dataset for the NeuroVSA arena. Each intent has canonical training phrases, held-out canonical test phrases (same phrasing style), and paraphrase test phrases (same meaning, deliberately different vocabulary). The canonical vs paraphrase split exposes the HDC-vs-embedding crossover: surface-form matching (HDC) should hold on canonical and degrade on paraphrase; semantic embeddings should hold on both.

intents.name: set_timer
train: set a timer for five minutes
start a countdown for fifteen minutes
test_canonical: set a timer for three minutes
test_paraphrase: let me know when ten minutes have passed
count down from five minutes
buzz me in a quarter of an hour

intents.name: play_music
test_paraphrase: I want to hear a tune
throw on a record
let's get some background sound going

intents.name: check_weather
train: is it going to be sunny
test_canonical: what is the weather this weekend
test_paraphrase: should I bring an umbrella
do I need a jacket today
is it pouring out there

intents.name: send_message
train: text sarah I'm on my way
send a message to the group
test_paraphrase: drop a line to my brother
shoot mike a quick word
let priya know I'll be late

intents.name: make_call
test_paraphrase: get grandma on the line
connect me to the front desk
put me through to support

intents.name: navigate
train: how do I get to the mall
route to the nearest gas station
test_paraphrase: what's the fastest way to the beach
guide me to the train station
plot a course to the hotel

intents.name: set_reminder
train: remind me to call the doctor
set a reminder for the meeting
remind me about the dentist at 3
set a reminder to water the plants
test_canonical: remind me to send the report
set a reminder for the interview
remind me to take my medicine
test_paraphrase: don't let me forget to lock the door
nudge me about the parking meter later
make sure I remember the anniversary

intents.name: control_lights
train: set the lights to fifty percent
switch on the living room lamp
test_paraphrase: it's too dark in here
kill the lights in the den
brighten up the office a bit

intents.name: check_calendar
train: do I have any meetings tomorrow
show me my calendar for next week
test_canonical: what's on my calendar this weekend
do I have any events monday
test_paraphrase: what have I got going on later
am I booked up thursday
walk me through my day

intents.name: translate_text
train: how do you say thank you in french
test_canonical: how do you say sorry in french
test_paraphrase: what's the portuguese word for house
render this sentence in dutch
give me the korean for welcome

intents.name: convert_currency
train: how much is 50 pounds in yen
exchange rate for dollars to rupees
test_canonical: how much is 30 pounds in dollars
test_paraphrase: what would 100 bucks get me in canadian money
how far does fifty quid go in swiss francs
price this in local currency for me

intents.name: define_word
train: what is the definition of ephemeral
test_canonical: what is the definition of candid
test_paraphrase: give me the meaning of quixotic
spell out what nuance really means
I don't know the word laconic, explain it

intents.name: news_briefing
train: catch me up on the news
test_paraphrase: fill me in on current events
what's going on out there
bring me up to speed on today

intents.name: adjust_volume
test_paraphrase: I can barely hear this
it's way too loud in here
silence the audio for a second

intents.name: add_todo
train: add milk to my todo list
put laundry on my task list
add finish the report to my todos
create a task to call the plumber
add pick up dry cleaning to my list
test_canonical: add eggs to my todo list
put gym on my task list
add reply to emails to my todos
test_paraphrase: jot down that I need to renew my passport
stick grocery shopping on the list
I should remember to schedule an oil change, save that
